method: Every EV id cited anywhere in packs/writing-content/ was read back from registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched and no licence was inferred: licence_state is derived from the ledger row's own licence text and from whether that row carries a licence_evidence line. Carried expression was checked by reading the pack's read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides, refs, exemplars) and by scanning every quoted span in it.

carried_expression.note: One quoted span of six words or more in the read surface, a six-word gloss of the CLDR plural category `one` in PACK.md B2, attributed to EV-0443 and well inside fair quotation. No style guide's word list, A to Z or rule text is carried, which is the specific risk B9 exists to name.
